chemistry_notes: Two-stage oxidative amidation. Stage 1 (5 mL coil) oxidizes benzyl alcohol to benzoyl intermediate using TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4. Stage 2 (10 mL coil) amidates with morpholine added at interstage. TBHP and morpholine are incompatible and must be segregated. Thermal reaction at 80 C. No light source required. BPR recommended due to proximity to solvent boiling point (dioxane bp 101 C) and safety with peroxides.
